name: plataforma-servicios
description: Landing + panel administrativo + gestor de órdenes F.I.S.C. (Next.js + NestJS)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
